question: The power of a convex lens of focal length 20 cm is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **5.0 D**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Power of a convex lens**

 
 
• **​**The power of a lens is its capacity to alter the** light** that enters it. Because a lens with a **shorter focal length bends lights more**, it has more power.
 
• The light rays** converge **toward the **principal axis in a convex lens**, while the light rays **diverge** away from the **principal axis in a concave lens**.
 
• Here, **P=1/f**
 
• The **inverse** of a lens's focal length (f) in meters (m) is its power.
 
• A lens's power is measured in m⁻¹. **Diopter** is another name for this.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Calculations**

 
 
• Given,** Convex lens**

 Focal Length, **f** = 20cm= 20/100=**0.2m** 

 We know, **P=1/f**

 So putting values in formula

 P=1/0.2=10/2

 **P= 5.0D**
